attributes.title: Xe.works
attributes.description: For many years, Xe has been demonstrating top-notch quality in the ad tech market. Xe's solutions are innovative, easy to use, and most importantly, they always deliver results. However, what Xe is most proud of is its team. And this is a team of true professionals who are passionate about their work.

attributes.title: ThermoKonnect
attributes.description: ThermoKonnect, a specialist in high-quality terminal junction splices for seamless electrical connections, needed a revamped digital presence to reflect their industry expertise. The goal was to build a modern e-commerce platform, complete with detailed 3D product renders, that showcased their top-tier partnerships with aerospace giants like Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Bombardier, and Bell Helicopter, while reinforcing their commitment to precision engineering and compliance.

attributes.title: OpenCall.ai
attributes.description: OpenCall AI provides an intelligent call center platform that automates phone interactions and business workflows through AI. Our task was to create a digital presence that clearly communicates the platform’s capabilities and demonstrates how AI can transform everyday phone operations into efficient, scalable business processes.

attributes.title: Thrust
attributes.description: ThrustThrust Network needed a digital presence that could reflect its ambitious place in the Web3 space while supporting the growth of its ecosystem. In addition to creating the new website, we also contributed to product design, helping shape a platform where ideas, collaboration, and innovation could meet in a clear and compelling way.

attributes.title: Mattr
attributes.description: Máttr was conceived as a new generation eyewear brand redefining what optical instruments could be. Instead of treating glasses as fashion accessories, the brand positioned them as precision-engineered objects – closer to Swiss watches than conventional eyewear. Our role was to design a digital experience that communicated this philosophy of craftsmanship, durability, and radical customization.

attributes.title: Aeve
attributes.description: Aeve.ai is an innovative AI-powered platform designed to transform the way property managers operate. Built for modern hospitality ecosystems, the product aims to streamline operations and introduce intelligent automation for platforms used by companies such as Airbnb, Booking, and Couchsurfing. Our goal was to create a digital presence that reflected the product’s technological ambition and forward-thinking vision.

attributes.title: Kira Rudik
attributes.description: Kira Rudik, a Ukrainian MP and a leading voice in digital transformation, needed a personal website that would effectively showcase her work and activities. The objective was to create a platform that reflected her professional identity with a clean and minimalist design,, meaningful user experience, and a comprehensive search function for news updates.

attributes.title: Tarotoo
attributes.description: Tarotoo sought to create an enchanting digital experience that would bring the mystical world of tarot to life. Our task was to develop a portfolio that felt like an immersive app, blending complex animations, illustration art direction, and AI features for engaging user interaction—all while optimizing for search engines to ensure the magic was easily found.

attributes.title: TankAir
attributes.description: Tank Air is a quality clothing brand created in service of the matriarchy. The team approached us to design and develop an e-commerce experience that would bring their vision to life online – combining strong brand character with a smooth and engaging shopping journey.

attributes.title: The OS Agency
attributes.description: The OS needed a portfolio that would embody their new brand identity and showcase their unique ability to blend creativity with marketing. The goal was to create an online experience that reflected their expertise in producing high-quality creative assets and optimizing digital processes while engaging audiences with innovative and captivating design

attributes.title: Bird Collaborative
attributes.description: For Bird Collaborative, a sustainable products company, our goal was to design and develop a digital experience that reflects their commitment to eco-friendly innovation while making their products accessible to a broader audience.

attributes.talk_subtitle: Just one small action stands between us and getting acquainted. A great journey begins with the first word "hello!"
